data.long_meaning: Goddess Kripa is the embodiment of divine compassion, mercy, and forgiveness. She is also known as the 'Mother of the Universe' and the 'Goddess of Protection'. She is believed to bestow her blessings on all her devotees, offering them protection, peace, and happiness.

Her name is a reminder of the boundless love and mercy that is always available to us, no matter what challenges we may face in life.
